etymologies.etymologyHTML: From innovate +‎ -ive.

definitions.definition: Characterized by the creation of new ideas or inventions.

quote.citation: 2021 May 19, David Clough, “Swiss precision meets UK growth”, in RAIL, number 931, page 57:
quote.text: He says the company's FLIRT design, in particular its retractable steps, provides greater accessibility, while the technology is highly innovative and reliable.
